page.overview:
What is Rosie Porkchop?

is the antagonist of Together Forever, the third story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Rosie Porkchop is a huge, life-sized pink pig animatronic with a broad head and fuzzy skin. She wears a frilly waitress uniform in a shade of pink slightly darker than her skin and a pillbox-shaped pink cap with a ruffled edge. Besides Rosie's outfit and fuzzy hands, she looks similar to a real pig. She has a pink potbelly, stubby legs, a curly tail, and a sweet, smiling face. Rosie is also old, as Jessica can see glinting silver showing through her pink felt layer in various spots. Her fingers are only slightly padded by pink felt. Rosie’s lower belly can pop open, revealing a network of metal gears, prongs, and sharp rods lining the interior wall. Rosie’s stomach is big enough to fit two people at most.

Rosie Porkchop is a springlock suit similar to Fredbear and Spring Bonnie and most likely shares traits from the two, being able to switch from springlock to costume at will. Rosie is shown to be programable from a laptop in both suit and animatronic form and will follow set programming once uploaded. Rosie is also shown to have immense strength, as if someone is grabbed by her, they will not be able to break free until told to by the programming.
